# Template Catalog Demo Notice

## About This Site
This site is a sanitized template environment. All visible names, copy, product data, contact details, logo assets, favicon assets, and claims are placeholders that must be replaced before production use.

## How To Treat It
- Safe for layout review, QA, staging, and internal previews
- Not a live supplier profile
- Not a verified catalog or legal source of truth

## Placeholder Areas
1. Homepage, about, services, contact, product listing, and legal copy
2. Product cards, detail descriptions, and testimonials
3. Logo, favicon, and product imagery
4. Contact channels, email addresses, and metadata

## Publish Rule
Do not present this site as a real business until all placeholder content has been replaced with approved production data.
